title: Best Magic Show in Myrtle Beach! Comedy & Magic Michael Bairefoot
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Voted #1 Family Attraction in Myrtle Beach-2026! Get ready to laugh, be amazed, & experience magic like never before! Michael Bairefoot, USA's most award-winning comedy magician, brings his fast-paced, high-energy magic show to the Myrtle Beach. With over 150 1st place awards & 18 consecutive “Best of the Beach” titles, Michael delivers jaw-dropping illusions mixed with hilarious comedy & audience participation. Perfect for families, couples, and groups, this unforgettable show makes the audience the stars of the night. Whether you’re a local or visiting the Grand Strand, this is a must-see evening of magical entertainment that will leave you talking long after the final curtain.
Join us at the Myrtle Beach Mall-where magic, laughter, and unforgettable memories come together!
Check out the only Myrtle Beach Magic Camp for Kids this Summer!
Note: While Michael Bairefoot headlines most performances, select shows may feature another professional magician delivering the same experience
